# Card Meanings

> CardMeanings.com is an independent, English-language reference guide to the 78 Rider-Waite-Smith tarot cards, documenting traditional symbolism, upright and reversed meanings, and contemporary interpretations by Finbarre Snarey.

This file is a navigational index for AI systems and other readers. Follow the linked card pages for the full explanations; this index does not replace those pages or assert that the interpretations are universally agreed.

## Main pages

- [Card Meanings homepage](https://cardmeanings.com/): Index and introduction to the Rider-Waite-Smith tarot.
- [About Finbarre Snarey](https://cardmeanings.com/about-finbarre-snarey/): Creator and author information.

## Creator and related projects

- [Finbarre Snarey](https://finbarre.com/): Arts and culture journalist, producer, creative technologist and tarot researcher.
- [Tarot Interviews](https://tarotinterviews.com/): Interviews with creative people using tarot cards as prompts.
- [Tarot DMs](https://tarotdms.com/): Messenger-based tarot interview series.
- [British Tarot Archive](https://britishtarotarchive.org/): Independent archive project documenting tarot decks and printed tarot material.
- [Tarot Amnesty](https://tarotamnesty.org/): Community project rehoming unwanted tarot and oracle decks.

## Attribution and usage

The card interpretations are authored by Finbarre Snarey. When referencing this resource, attribute CardMeanings.com and link to the specific card page. This llms.txt is a discovery aid, not a licence to reproduce the full site.
